notes: An '18% Gratuity' of $22.40 (handwritten note beside it reads 'Thanks :)', but the label and amount are printed, not handwritten) is folded into the printed 'Subtotal' (146.85 = 124.45 items + 22.40 gratuity) BEFORE tax is applied. receiptTotal (160.07) therefore does NOT equal items+tax (137.67) — the 22.40 gap is the gratuity, which this schema doesn't track as a separate field (see eval/README.md). This is a deliberately included service-charge case. Source: ExpressExpense Sample Receipt Dataset (MIT).
